missing_data_policy: Exclude a session with any missing timestamp, answer, or required metric; preserve its record and report excluded counts. Never impute or score a missing answer as zero. Reject invalid, mismatched, duplicate, or unassigned sessions.

session_quality_policy.short_time_action: Exclude from primary analysis; retain and report by arm. Reading duration below 30 seconds is a predeclared proxy for invalid exposure, not a grade norm.
session_quality_policy.long_gap_action: Exclude from primary analysis if a verified inactivity gap exceeds 300 seconds; if inactivity cannot be measured, report the limitation and do not infer uninterrupted reading from elapsed time alone.
session_quality_policy.straight_line_action: Flag identical responses to all same-format items for blinded manual review; do not automatically exclude open-text answers or all-identical Likert burden ratings without corroborating evidence.
session_quality_policy.prior_exposure_action: Exclude a participant who reports prior exposure to either frozen F02 version or its items before assignment; preserve count and reason.
session_quality_policy.carryover_action: One F02 version per participant across every arm. A second-version exposure invalidates that participant's primary session; no within-person order correction is attempted.
session_quality_policy.incomplete_action: Retain the partial record, exclude it from complete-case primary analysis, report missingness by arm and item. No replacement beyond the predeclared maximum assignments.

purpose: Calibration of F02 instruments and difficulty judgments; no gold or DB seed

target_fit.aggregation: Mean for accuracy; median for all other metrics. Inclusive bounds. Only hard_gate metrics determine TARGET_FIT; supporting and diagnostic deviations are reported without averaging into a composite. Missing required data is insufficient evidence.

level_separation.design: Randomly assign high_1 students between high_target (frozen high_1 passage) and middle_anchor (frozen middle_1 passage); each student reads one F02 version only. The high_target arm serves target fit and common-grade comparison. Do not infer separation by comparing middle_1 and high_1 target cohorts.
level_separation.primary: Median reasoning_burden(high_1 passage) - median reasoning_burden(middle_1 passage) reaches minimum_reasoning_burden_gap
level_separation.secondary: Median sentence_burden(high_1 passage) - median sentence_burden(middle_1 passage) reaches minimum_sentence_burden_gap. A lexical-only gap never passes.
level_separation.decision: PASS only when reasoning and sentence burden gaps and both comprehension floors pass; FAIL when complete eligible arms violate any condition; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Require a human construct review before interpreting the direction as the intended axis rather than an item artifact.
level_separation.measurement_caveat: Anchor cohorts need parallel, independently reviewed questions with common constructs and blinded scoring; version-specific item differences and sample uncertainty remain calibration findings. Do not claim generalizable level separation from this one pair.

promotion_rule: educationally_validated requires target_fit_pass for both grades and separation_pass after human construct review; calibration alone never grants gold or seed_eligible. Gold requires independent human meaning and cross-domain validation; seed_eligible additionally requires current rights, provenance, hashes and gates.
rationale: These are deliberately broad operational pilot bands, not published Korean grade norms. Comprehension is the non-compensatory target-fit floor. Other metrics diagnose burden and guide a future independently registered study; a small timing overrun cannot alone fail this calibration. Separation requires reasoning and syntax-related burden rather than rare vocabulary alone. A human lead must review and seal the numbers, instruments, allocation, exclusions, and administration before seeing responses. A revision after response access starts a new study.
